chapter: Circus shows and learning to voice
title: Bands not ready for rich voicings
summary: Bands could not read or hear anything beyond triads, though he wrote six-sax voicings for Battles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: So, now I got some things where you can do seven-part harmony and that sounds all right, but you need instrumentation to do it. So I made one for Battles with his six saxes, top to bottom, all six-part harmony, commercial melody. That was about three years ago, it's still in the books.
Well, actually, of course, in a way, the bands weren't ready for this, were they?
No. I mean, they couldn't even hear it.
I mean, they couldn't read it, they couldn't -- there were almost too many people who couldn't read well.
Yeah, and even if they'd read the note they didn't hear well.
They could only hear the triad.
Yeah, yeah. Well, that's what was in their head.
